title: Evaluating sin^2(pi/12) via the Half-Angle Formula
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use a half-angle identity to find the exact value of \sin^2(\pi/12).

steps.title: State the Half-Angle Formula for Sine Squared
steps.explanation: Recall the half-angle identity sin^2(theta) = (1 - cos(2*theta))/2.
steps.why: Solving the double-angle formula cos(2*theta) = 1 - 2*sin^2(theta) for sin^2(theta) yields this identity.

steps.title: Substitute theta = pi/12
steps.explanation: With theta = pi/12, the double angle is 2*theta = pi/6.

steps.title: Substitute cos(pi/6) and Simplify
steps.explanation: Substitute cos(pi/6) = sqrt(3)/2 and multiply top and bottom by 2.
steps.why: Clearing the fraction inside the numerator gives (2 - sqrt(3))/4.
